ns2:course.label: Laboratory Animal Medicine
ns2:course.description: (V C M 442) Weekly clinical rounds, weekly or biweekly facilities rounds, and supervised clinical experience. Topics include: biology and husbandry of laboratory animals; diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease of laboratory animals; principles of animal use in research and teaching; and management and design of laboratory animal facilities. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: DVM or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
